announcement.label: Announcement
announcement.useWhen: One launch or piece of news: a headline, a date, and what's new
announcement.avoidWhen: Several pieces of news at once (use newsletter), or a link preview for an article (use og-card)

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.useWhen: Recognizing someone for finishing or achieving something: who, what, when, and who signs it
certificate.avoidWhen: A ticket or a pass (use ticket), or a letter with paragraphs of text (use letter)

event.label: Event
event.useWhen: An event people can come to: what it is, when and where, and how to register
event.avoidWhen: A ticket someone already has (use ticket), or one speaker's announcement (use speaker)

invoice.label: Invoice
invoice.useWhen: A bill the reader has to pay: what it's for, how much, and when it's due
invoice.avoidWhen: A payment already made (use receipt), or an estimate before work starts (use quote)

magic-link.label: Magic link
magic-link.useWhen: A one-time link that signs the reader in without a password
magic-link.avoidWhen: A code to type (use sign-in-code), or resetting a password (use password-reset)

newsletter.label: Newsletter
newsletter.useWhen: A regular issue of written news: a subject, a lead, and sections the writer fills in
newsletter.avoidWhen: One announcement (use announcement), or a summary built from data (use digest)

og-card.label: Open Graph card
og-card.useWhen: The picture a link shows when it's shared: an article's or a page's title, with the brand
og-card.avoidWhen: A launch with features and a product picture (use announcement), or an ad (use ad)

order-confirmation.label: Order confirmation
order-confirmation.useWhen: Confirming an order was placed: what's in it, what it costs, and where it's going
order-confirmation.avoidWhen: Proof of a payment for a subscription (use receipt), or an order on its way (use shipping)

password-reset.label: Password reset
password-reset.useWhen: A link to choose a new password, after someone asked to reset theirs
password-reset.avoidWhen: A code to type instead of a link (use sign-in-code), or telling someone their password was changed (use security-alert)

quote.label: Quote
quote.useWhen: An estimate before work starts: what's included, what it costs, and how long the price holds
quote.avoidWhen: A bill to be paid (use invoice), or a full proposal with its approach and terms (use proposal)

receipt.label: Receipt
receipt.useWhen: Proof of a payment already made: what was bought, what it cost, and when it was paid
receipt.avoidWhen: A bill still to be paid (use invoice), or an order that hasn't been charged yet (use order-confirmation)

shipping.label: Shipping
shipping.useWhen: Telling someone their order is on its way: who's carrying it, when it should arrive, and how to track it
shipping.avoidWhen: Confirming an order was placed (use order-confirmation), or one that has arrived (use delivered)

sign-in-code.label: Sign-in code
sign-in-code.useWhen: A one-time code the reader types to sign in or to confirm an action
sign-in-code.avoidWhen: A link to click instead of a code (use magic-link), or resetting a password (use password-reset)

speaker.label: Speaker
speaker.useWhen: Announcing one speaker for an event: who they are, what they'll talk about, and when
speaker.avoidWhen: The whole event (use event), or a quote from someone (use quote-card)

ticket.label: Ticket
ticket.useWhen: A ticket someone holds for an event: who it's for, when and where, and the code to show at the door
ticket.avoidWhen: Inviting people to an event (use event), or a receipt for the ticket's price (use receipt)

verify-email.label: Verify email
verify-email.useWhen: A link that confirms an email address belongs to the person who signed up with it
verify-email.avoidWhen: A code to type (use sign-in-code), or a first hello with next steps (use welcome)

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.useWhen: The first email after someone signs up: a greeting, a few next steps and one button
welcome.avoidWhen: Confirming an email address (use verify-email), or a series of onboarding emails with different content

    <Email

      title="What's new this month"
      previewText="Faster exports, notes in your own voice, and a date for the open house"
      lang={brand.lang ?? "en"}

      theme={brand.theme}
      fonts={brand.fonts}

        backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
        fontSize: token("fontSizes.body"),

        <Row

          style={{ alignItems: "center", gap: token("spacing.md"), padding: [0, token("spacing.sm")] }}

          <Column>
            <Image
              src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }}
              alt={brand.logo.alt}
              style={{ width: 140 }}
            />
          </Column>
          <Column>
            <Text
              style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted"), textAlign: "right" }}
            >
              No. 14 · March 5

          </Column>

        <Column

            backgroundColor: token("colors.background"),
            borderRadius: token("radii.md"),

        >
          <Column style={{ padding: token("spacing.xl"), gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Text

                fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"),

              This month

              We rebuilt the export pipeline from the ground up. Big projects that took minutes now take seconds, and there's nothing to change in your settings to get it.

              href={`${brand.links.site}/blog/faster-exports`}
              style={{ borderRadius: token("radii.sm"), padding: [token("spacing.sm"), token("spacing.lg")] }}

              Read about faster exports

          </Column>
          <Column style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")], gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
            <Divider />
            <Heading level={2}>Also in this issue</Heading>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start" }}>
              <Column style={{ width: 140 }}>
                <Image
                  src={{
                    src: "https://hyperelements.dev/generated/kits/assets/kits/editorial/recorder.png",
                    width: 1020,

                <Heading level={3}>
                  <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/blog/your-voice`} style={{ textDecoration: "none" }}>
                    Notes that sound like you
                  </Link>
                </Heading>
                <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>
                  Release notes now start from what you've written before, so a first draft already has your voice.
                </Text>
              </Column>
            </Row>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start" }}>
              <Column style={{ width: 140 }}>

                </Heading>
                <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>
                  Boards you share outside your team get cleaner cards and a calmer layout.
                </Text>
              </Column>
            </Row>
            <Row style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "start" }}>
              <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.xs") }}>
                <Heading level={3}>
                  <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/events/office-hours`} style={{ textDecoration: "none" }}>
                    Office hours, every other Thursday

                </Heading>

                  Bring a question, or just listen in. We answer what you ask, live.

              </Column>
            </Row>
          </Column>
          <Column style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")] }}>

          </Text>
        </Column>
      </Column>
    </Email>
  );
}

templates.code:
// summit/emails/event.tsx, from hyperelements.dev/templates. Render it with render(<SummitEvent />) from
// "@hyper-elements/react"; your brand goes in ./brand.ts.

import { Button, Column, Email, Heading, Image, Link, Row, Section, Text, token } from "@hyper-elements/react";
import { brand } from "./brand";

export const meta = {
  label: "Event invitation",
  description: "An invitation: the event's name on a band of the brand's color, when and where, a button to register, and the day's schedule",
};

export default function SummitEvent() {
  return (
    <Email
      width={600}
      title="You're invited to Build Day"
      previewText="Thursday, May 14, The Foundry. A day of talks and workshops for the people who build and ship software."
      lang={brand.lang ?? "en"}
      dir={brand.dir}
      theme={brand.theme}
      fonts={brand.fonts}
      style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.body"), lineHeight: token("lineHeights.body") }}
    >
      <Section style={{ padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.xl")] }}>
        <Image
          src={{ src: brand.logo.src, width: brand.logo.width, height: brand.logo.height }}
          alt={brand.logo.alt}
          style={{ width: 140 }}
        />
      </Section>
      <Section
        style={{
          backgroundColor: token("colors.primary"),
          color: token("colors.primaryForeground"),
          padding: [token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")],
        }}
      >
        <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.sm") }}>
          <Text
            style={{
              fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"),
              fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: 1.5,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
            }}
          >
            You're invited
          </Text>
          <Heading level={1} style={{ color: token("colors.primaryForeground") }}>Build Day</Heading>
          <Text>A day of talks and workshops for the people who build and ship software.</Text>
        </Column>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.lg")] }}>
        <Column style={{ gap: token("spacing.lg") }}>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md"), alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 76 }}>
              <Column
                style={{
                  width: 76,
                  backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
                  borderRadius: token("radii.md"),
                  padding: [10, 0],
                }}
              >
                <Text
                  style={{
                    fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"),
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    letterSpacing: 1.5,
                    textTransform: "uppercase",
                    color: token("colors.primary"),
                    textAlign: "center",
                  }}
                >
                  May
                </Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.1, textAlign: "center" }}>14</Text>
              </Column>
            </Column>
            <Column style={{ gap: 2 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>Thursday, May 14</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>9:30 AM to 6:00 PM</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: token("colors.muted") }}>The Foundry, 120 Mill Street, Pittsburgh</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Button
            href={`${brand.links.site}/events/build-day`}
            style={{ borderRadius: token("radii.sm"), padding: [token("spacing.sm"), token("spacing.lg")] }}
          >
            Register for Build Day
          </Button>
        </Column>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [0, token("spacing.xl"), token("spacing.xl")] }}>
        <Column
          style={{
            gap: token("spacing.sm"),
            border: { top: { width: 1, style: "solid", color: token("colors.border") } },
            padding: [token("spacing.lg"), 0, 0],
          }}
        >
          <Heading level={2}>The day</Heading>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>9:30 AM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Doors open, coffee and breakfast</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>10:00 AM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Opening talk: shipping weekly without breaking anything</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>1:00 PM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Workshops, in four rooms</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
          <Row stackOnMobile={false} style={{ gap: token("spacing.md") }}>
            <Column style={{ width: 96 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: token("colors.primary") }}>5:00 PM</Text>
            </Column>
            <Column>
              <Text>Closing panel, then drinks on the roof</Text>
            </Column>
          </Row>
        </Column>
      </Section>
      <Section
        style={{
          backgroundColor: token("colors.surface"),
          padding: [token("spacing.lg"), token("spacing.xl")],
        }}
      >
        <Text style={{ fontSize: token("fontSizes.small"), color: token("colors.muted") }}>
          {brand.name} · {brand.address}{" · "}
          <Link href={`${brand.links.site}/unsubscribe`}>Stop event invitations</Link>
        </Text>
      </Section>
    </Email>
  );
}
